entries.description: Ported header + Section A (path defs with lilypondPath-preferred/svgPathToLilypond fallback, path/hollow/attachment registrations with 4-point anchor conversion, CB-safe color conditional per LY spec 4.5) into cnb/src/cnb-lilypond.js

Ported Section B (staff geometry always-emitted with staff-line-positions conversion, emit-if-changed engine settings, thickness pct-to-staff-space conversion per LY spec 5.3, metadata) plus 34 unit tests in cnb/tests/cnb-lilypond-tests.js; cnb suite 242 pass, legacy 240 pass
Built CNBLilypond.sectionC() (memv/cond grouping, duration-aware compound conditions, repeat field) and generate() with LY spec §8 export validation; all 259 cnb tests pass

Added Section C/generate/parity tests incl. semantic diff vs legacy generateSectionC for the default 4-8 config; 259 cnb + 240 legacy tests pass; manual UAT review of full generated .ly against CNB-LY-EXPORT-SPEC-v1_2 worked examples complete
